protocol.geometry_rule: Same abs distance/median positive gap,cap20,two signed scalars initialized0;finite global attention
protocol.labels: Original public released fit target masks only,no new remask views or extra teacher positions. Same exact patches/labels/cell exposures for each seed pair.
protocol.baseline_scope: Full-label existing LGB and frozen A47 selected TCN with density auxiliary loss;available dates match,actual repeated patch exposure differs from trees.
protocol.initialization: Common tensor bytes identical per seed;relative coefficients0. No dropout;only stored patch plans sample training.
protocol.checkpoint: Pure neural ordinary cal State every4epochs,first max
protocol.reference: Max cal of existing frozen models;incumbent wins exact tie
protocol.hybrid: New equal-seed speed plus strongest existing reference flow,no weight search
protocol.primary: Keep existing reference unless candidate cal gain>=.0005 and min regime gain>=-.001;max eligible cal. New plain GRU also eligible.
protocol.assessment: Old public development dates,read after four fits/checkpoints/alphas/reference/primary seal;not final/private
protocol.future_scope: Pre-fit fixed public research calendar,previously viewed for other studies,not final/private
